election: 2022 election to the PLO Executive Committee by the PLO Central Council (Ramallah)
role_sought: Member of the Executive Committee of the Palestine Liberation Organization (independent)
detail: An indirect election by the Central Council, convened for the first time since 2018, to fill seats left vacant by death and resignation; Mustafa took the seat of Hanan Ashrawi and Hussein al-Sheikh that of Saeb Erekat. Hamas and Islamic Jihad refused to attend and other factions criticised the session (see polemics). No vote counts were published in the sources consulted. Mustafa has never stood in a popular election; no presidential election has been held since 2005 and no legislative election since 2006.

election: Confidence in the 19th government granted by presidential decree (no parliamentary vote)
role_sought: Prime Minister of the State of Palestine
detail: Designated by President Abbas on 14 March 2024, Mustafa presented his cabinet and programme on 28 March; Abbas issued decrees granting confidence and approving the government, which was sworn in on 31 March 2024. There was no vote by the Legislative Council, which is not functioning; the AMAN Coalition notes that Mustafa's reply to the letter of designation served as a substitute for the ministerial statement normally presented to the Council.
